title: The Tower of Babel and the Line of Shem

verses.1: Now the whole earth had one language and the same words.
verses.2: As people migrated from the east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.
verses.3: They said to one another, "Come, let us make bricks and fire them thoroughly." They used brick instead of stone and bitumen for mortar.
verses.4: Then they said, "Come, let us build ourselves a city and a tower with its top in the heavens. Let us make a name for ourselves, so that we will not be scattered over the face of the whole earth."
verses.5: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the people were building.
verses.6: The LORD said, "They are one people with one language, and this is only the beginning of what they will do. Nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.
verses.7: Come, let Us go down and confuse their language there, so that they will not understand one another's speech."
verses.8: So the LORD scattered them from there over the face of all the earth, and they stopped building the city.
verses.9: That is why it was called Babel — because there the LORD confused the language of the whole earth, and from there the LORD scattered them over the face of all the earth.
verses.10: These are the generations of Shem. When Shem was 100 years old, he fathered Arpachshad, two years after the flood.
verses.11: After he fathered Arpachshad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.12: When Arpachshad had lived 35 years, he fathered Shelah.
verses.13: After he fathered Shelah, Arpachshad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.14: When Shelah had lived 30 years, he fathered Eber.
verses.15: After he fathered Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.16: When Eber had lived 34 years, he fathered Peleg.
verses.17: After he fathered Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.18: When Peleg had lived 30 years, he fathered Reu.
verses.19: After he fathered Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.20: When Reu had lived 32 years, he fathered Serug.
verses.21: After he fathered Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.22: When Serug had lived 30 years, he fathered Nahor.
verses.23: After he fathered Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.24: When Nahor had lived 29 years, he fathered Terah.
verses.25: After he fathered Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.26: After Terah had lived 70 years, he fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.27: These are the generations of Terah. Terah fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran fathered Lot.
verses.28: Haran died in the presence of his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldeans.
verses.29: Abram and Nahor took wives. Abram's wife was named Sarai, and Nahor's wife was named Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.
verses.30: Now Sarai was barren; she had no child.
verses.31: Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot the son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, Abram's wife, and they set out together from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to the land of Canaan. But when they came to Haran, they settled there.
verses.32: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Haran.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
